title: 第26章 格调
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
牙人推开大门，这边房子贵，每隔些时间就会找些妇女打扫干净。

    花不了多少钱的同时，租客来时总能看见焕然一新的屋子。

    要是灰尘满地，蜘蛛结网，那肯定要被砍价钱。

    这年头，吃不起饭的多了去了，就这活几个铜板就能找到不少人来干。

    四合院门前带着个小院子，一棵树下有石桌石椅。

    院子打扫的也十分干净，看不见什么落叶杂草。

    “这边卫生我们隔三差五都会喊人来做。”牙人弯腰伸手示意他们进去看看。

    李应灵脚步先迈了进去，目光打量一圈。

    这里自然比不上李应灵家中规模，但远远比破庙好到不知道哪里去了。

    起码干净整洁，自己也不用补会漏风的门。

    李应灵走到石桌面前，伸手轻轻一抚，抬手一看确实没什么灰尘。

    她随意挑了右侧的偏房推门一看，里面也是收拾的干净。

    只是床上没有床垫和被子，书桌和椅子也是齐全的。

    楚星尘也迈步走进院内，目光打量了一圈，随后询问身边的厉行天道：

    “你觉得怎么样？”

    “师父觉得可以就行。”

    厉行天对于住的如何倒也是真的无所谓，否则他也不会选择真睡在破庙后面。

    牙人闻言微微一愣。

    师父？这一伙人的关系好像不是自己推测的那般。

    “师父，这里真不错呢。”

    李应灵从偏房中走出，神色表情对着房子似乎十分满意。

    牙人闻言连忙吹捧道：“那是自然，整个渝州城打听，这里地段和屋子都是顶尖的。”

    楚星尘看见自家大弟子满意的神色，很果断的就掏出了二十两银子。

    “先租半年，手续你自己办完再交给我便是。”

    牙人目光瞬间一亮，连忙答应接过银子，随后将门口的钥匙恭恭敬敬的递给了楚星尘。

    “好嘞，这是钥匙，租赁凭证今晚给您送来。”

    楚星尘接过钥匙后，牙人便十分有眼力见的退下离开。

    厉行天看自家师父租下这些东西后，果断背着身后的东西往里走去，将身后的锅碗瓢盆放到该放的地方去。

    “师父，你怎么会想来渝州城？”

    李应灵好奇的询问，她原本还以为师父还会带着她往某个山里去。
content_en:
Yaren opened the door. The houses here were expensive, and women would be found to clean them every once in a while.

It doesn’t cost much and at the same time, tenants can always see a brand new house when they come.

If the floor is full of dust and spiders are making webs, the price will definitely be reduced.

These days, there are so many people who can't afford to eat, and you can find many people to do this job for just a few coins.

There is a small courtyard in front of the courtyard, with stone tables and chairs under a tree.

The yard is also very clean, and there are no fallen leaves or weeds in sight.

"We call for people to do the sanitation here every now and then." The tooth man bent down and stretched out his hand to signal them to come in and take a look.

Li Yingling stepped in first and looked around.

This place is naturally not as big as Li Yingling's home, but it is far better than the ruined temple.

At least it's clean and tidy, and you don't have to fix the leaky door.

Li Yingling walked to the stone table, stretched out her hand and touched it gently. When she raised her hand, she saw that there was indeed no dust.

She randomly picked the side room on the right and opened the door to see that it was also tidy inside.

It's just that there is no mattress or quilt on the bed, and the desk and chair are also complete.

Chu Xingchen also stepped into the courtyard, looked around, and then asked Li Xingtian next to him:

"What do you think?"

"As long as Master thinks it's okay."

Li Xingtian really didn't care how he lived, otherwise he wouldn't have chosen to sleep behind the ruined temple.

The tooth man was slightly startled when he heard this.

Master?The relationship between this group of people does not seem to be what I imagined.

"Master, it's really nice here."

Li Yingling walked out of the side room, looking very satisfied with the house.

Hearing this, Yaren hurriedly boasted: "That's natural. In the entire Yuzhou City, the location and houses here are top-notch."

Seeing his eldest disciple's satisfied look, Chu Xingchen decisively took out twenty taels of silver.

"Let it be rented for half a year first. You can complete the procedures yourself and then leave it to me."

Yaren's eyes instantly brightened, and he quickly agreed to take the money, and then respectfully handed the key to the door to Chu Xingchen.

"Okay, here's the key. The rental voucher will be sent to you tonight."

After Chu Xingchen took the key, Yaren stepped back and left with great discernment.

After Li Xingtian saw his master renting these things, he decisively walked in carrying the things behind him and put the pots and pans behind him where they should be put.

"Master, why do you want to come to Yuzhou City?"

Li Yingling asked curiously. She originally thought that the master would take her to a certain mountain.
